file_reasoning: CallCenter workspace composition and order/reprint overlays.

resource_binding_reasoning.reasoning: No-shift pane offers refresh only; this client intentionally cannot open shift. Active workspace fixed420px intake plus remaining catalogue; no responsive breakpoint in markup.
Shared VM inherited by nested address component. Later overlays stack variant, result, lookup, so VM exclusive flags essential; no native modal focus isolation defined.
Variant buttons root-command bind correctly; pending offer shown explicitly. MaxHeight500 stack has no ScrollViewer, many sizes/large text may clip; native unobserved.

Confirmation reports recorded order and conditional print warning with separate RetryPrint. Order success never equated with successful physical print. StartNewOrder gates CanEditOperation, supporting unresolved print blocking.
MaxHeight560 fixed420 stack lacks scroll. Long errors/customer/address/payment lines can exceed it. Shows subtotal total and status, not full items/receipt preview.

Warning versus muted brush and explicit LookedUpPaymentLine communicate unconfirmed electronic money. Reprint button routes ReprintLookedUpOrderCommand, source UI012 kitchen-route issue remains outside markup.

recommendations: Use bounded scroll in variant/lookup overlays; preserve real-order versus print status distinction and native focus validation.
